title: An edit to the config file is applied without a restart; a broken edit leaves the daemon running and says so; fixing it recovers

steps.why: The person adds a watched repo to the config file; nobody restarts the daemon
An editor leaves the file half written
The file is fixed, and says something new

expect.name: edit-applied
expect.why: The daemon reloaded the file by itself and started the forwarder

expect.name: says-invalid
expect.why: status shows the broken file as a first-class line

expect.name: still-watching
expect.why: The daemon went on running on the config it had

expect.name: fix-recovers
expect.why: Fixed, the file is applied; nothing stayed stuck on the invalid one
